package.name: CAT2_DFP
package.description: Infineon CAT2(CCG, PMG, PSOC4, WLC) Device Support

releases.release:
- Supported product lines: PSOC4, CCG, PMG, WLC
- Changes: - Added new devices: - PSOC4 HVPA SPM 1.0 - PSOC 4100T Plus 256KB - New CCG6_CFP MPNs - New CCG8_CFP MPNs - New PSOC 4 HV MS 128K MPNs - New PSOC 4100S Plus MPNs - New PSOC 4000T MPNs - New PSOC 4100T Plus MPNs

- Supported product lines: PSOC4, CCG, PMG, WLC
- Changes: - Added new devices: - PSOC 4100T Plus - New PMG1 MPNs

- Supported product lines: PSOC4, CCG, PMG, WLC
- Changes: - Added new devices: - New CCG7S MPNs - New CCG6_CFP MPNs - New CCG8_CFP MPNs - New PSOC 4 HV MS 64K MPNs - New PSOC 4 HV MS 128K MPNs - New PSOC 4 HV PA 144K MPNs - New PSOC 4000S MPNs - New PSOC 4100S Plus MPNs - New PSOC 4000T MPNs - Updated CAT2 CMSIS Flash Loaders to v2.1.0.205: bugfixes, performance and stability improvements. - Rehosted the pack to https://itools.infineon.com/cmsis_packs/CAT2_DFP/ URL.

- Supported product lines: PSOC4, CCG, PMG, WLC
- Changes: - Added new devices: - New PSOC4A MC MPNs - New WLC1 MPNs - New PSOC4AS4 MPNs - Updated CAT2 CMSIS Flash Loaders to v2.1.0.197: bugfixes, performance and stability improvements.

- Supported product lines: PSOC4, CCG, PMG, WLC
- Changes: - The vendor name and DeviceVendorEnum is changed from Cypress to Infineon. - Added new devices: - EZ-PD™ CCGx - EZ-PD™ PMGx - PSOC™ 4000T - PSOC™ 4500H - PSOC™ 4700S - WLCx - Added read and print of target device information. - Updated CAT2 CMSIS Flash Loaders to v2.1.0.194: bugfixes, performance and stability improvements.
